generationInputs.prompt: A cartoon white and tan Pikachu-like creature sits in a purple cereal bowl overflowing with light brown and white disk-shaped cereal with red and black eye and cheek details, against a black background with white stars, designed as a cereal box. The creature has black eyes, a jagged black mouth, long pointed ears with black tips, and wears a draped purple cloth. An orange glowing circle is behind the bowl. White text with a purple outline reads "MIMIKYU'S" above, and cursive purple "Mola" to the right. Curved white text on the left says "THE FAVORITE CEREAL OF YOUR GHOSTS". A purple starburst at the bottom left has "FREE DISGUISE INSIDE" in white, and a purple rectangle at the bottom right lists white-lettered nutritional information.
